theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Mobility requires absolute clarity, fast decision-making, and trust. The contrast of deep navy against stark white, paired with the signal yellow, creates an authoritative, technical 'dispatch' feel rather than a generic tech app.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background_light relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over perfect symmetry. Left-align text content, stretch actionable areas.

map_background.style: Full bleed absolute background. Use a desaturated or high-contrast silver map style to make the yellow/navy UI pop.
map_background.markers: Custom HTML markers. Pickup is a solid black square, Dropoff is a yellow square with navy dot.

bottom_sheet.layout: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-surface_white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_32px_rgba(11,20,38,0.12)] border-t border-navy_base/5 z-50 transition-transform duration-300 flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]
bottom_sheet.dragger: w-12 h-1.5 bg-border_subtle rounded-full mx-auto mt-3 mb-4

address_entry.style: Neumorphic-tactile hybrid. Instead of full boxes, use left-bordered segments.
address_entry.input_classes: w-full bg-transparent text-lg font-bold placeholder:font-normal placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none

live_price_estimate.style: Floating high-contrast card appearing instantly after address entry.
live_price_estimate.classes: bg-navy_base text-white p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between mb-6 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden
live_price_estimate.layout: Left: ETA + Mode name. Right: Giant price in Cabinet Grotesk. Add a subtle 10% opacity primary_yellow gradient beam tracing the top border.

mode_hub.layout_concept: The Tactical Bento Grid. Do not use 16 identical pills. Categorize them for cognitive ease.

categories.name: Everyday
categories.card_style: aspect-square bg-background_light border border-border_subtle rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-navy_base data-[state=active]:bg-navy_base data-[state=active]:text-white transition-colors

categories.name: Time & Distance
categories.layout: flex overflow-x-auto gap-3 pb-4 snap-x hide-scrollbar
categories.card_style: min-w-[140px] bg-surface_white border border-border_subtle rounded-xl p-3 snap-start

categories.name: Specialty & Inclusive
categories.card_style: px-4 py-2 bg-background_light text-sm rounded-full border border-transparent hover:border-border_subtle font-medium

dynamic_panels.style: Slide-down or accordion sections just above the CTA.
dynamic_panels.datetime_picker: Horizontal scroll of dates, vertical scroll of times. Minimalist black-and-white.
dynamic_panels.flight_number: Input field with airplane icon, validates format.

adaptive_cta.style: w-full bg-primary_yellow text-navy_base py-4 font-black text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-primary_yellow_hover active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
adaptive_cta.layout: Sticky to bottom of sheet with safe-area padding.

motion_and_interactions.price_reveal: Animate price entering with a slight Y-axis slide (framer-motion initial={{y:10, opacity:0}} animate={{y:0, opacity:1}}).
motion_and_interactions.bento_cards: On click, active cards invert to navy background, white text, and icon slightly scales up (scale 1.05).
motion_and_interactions.panel_slide: Mode specific panels animate in height (AnimatePresence) so layout shift is smooth, not jarring.

testing_attributes.rules: Every interactive element must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

icons_library.instruction: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Use 'Duotone' weight for Everyday category to feel premium, 'Regular' weight for the rest.
